Hi Samira / Tom,

Great speaking with you earlier — thanks for the time and for walking through the Acme requirements. As promised, attached is the proposal (commercial + recommended deployment options) that captures the configuration we discussed: a 2x-dedicated GPU pool for production with fallback to hosted for burst, and a 30-day evaluation window for validation.

Quick summary (TL;DR):
- Monthly committed capacity: 2x A100-equivalent GPUs (dedicated)
- Typical expectation: 15–20M tokens/mo; provisioning includes autoscale headroom to handle peak batch inference
- Observability add-on: longer retention for token-level traces (optional)
- Estimated first-year ARR range: $220k–$290k depending on burst usage and evaluation outcomes

Attachment: Redwood_Proposal_Acme_v2.pdf (PDF, 1.2MB)

Would you confirm you received the file? I can walk through it in a quick 15-minute call if useful — happy to run a short ops + cost walkthrough and call out tradeoffs between Dedicated vs Hosted burst behavior.

Proposed slots: Thu Apr 29 10:00–10:15 PT, Thu Apr 29 14:00–14:15 PT, or Fri Apr 30 09:00–09:15 PT. If none work, tell me a couple of times that do and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Diego Fernandez
